title: Cinnamon Israeli Couscous
description: Cinnamon-flavored Israeli couscous, broccoli, dried cranberries, and almonds are a delicious combination in this side dish that's perfect for Thanksgiving or any night of the week.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable bouillon base (such as Better Than Bouillon® Vegetable Base), or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, or to taste

steps.text: Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat; stir in onion. Cook and stir until the onion has softened and turned translucent, about 5 minutes. Add couscous and stir until light brown.

Add water, bouillon, cinnamon, garam masala, and bay leaf; bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until water is absorbed, 8 to 10 minutes. Add cranberries, broccoli, and almonds, and allow to steam under the lid until softened, about 3 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and garnish with parsley. Serve warm.
